Do not add "Co-Authored-By: Claude" or any Claude-related attribution in commit messages.

**Why:** User explicitly requested this — they don't want AI attribution in their git history.

**How to apply:** Never include Co-Authored-By, "Generated by Claude", or similar lines in any git commit messages.
